# Introduction
There are many recent trends in the smart mobility industry such as electrification, 
autonomous driving and ride-hailing. In particular the last trend in combination with 
an electric fleet which optimal operates autonomously is the subject of this work. 
Commissioned by a renowned German car company this work analyses the potential of such a 
ride-hailing platform in the US. The work is a pilot project as the car company lacks in 
know-how. 

We, Bane & Wayne Partners are a team of data scientists which already have experience 
in piloting such work. Our goal is to equip the client with the analytical foundation.

This paper uses data of the City of Chicago to perform such an analyses.  First, the 
data is preprocessed as described in @sec-data-cleaning. Continuing, with descriptive 
temporal-spatial analysis in @sec-descriptive-analysis. In a third step, prediction 
models are developed, assessed and compared to estimate the expected demand depending 
on environmental, time and spatial parameters in @sec-demand-prediction. Lastly, @sec-rl 
discusses smart charging and its potential tp reduce costs using a reinforcement approach 
and a learning agent.
